lessons.title: Introduction to Programming
lessons.focus: What programming is, how programs work, programming languages, compilers, and interpreters

lessons.title: Programming Fundamentals
lessons.focus: Syntax, statements, variables, constants, data types, and comments

lessons.title: Operators and Expressions
lessons.focus: Arithmetic operators, comparison operators, logical operators, assignment operators, and operator precedence

lessons.title: Input and Output
lessons.focus: Receiving user input, displaying output, formatting output, and handling basic user interactions

lessons.title: Decision Making
lessons.focus: If statements, if-else statements, nested conditions, and switch statements

lessons.title: Loops and Repetition
lessons.focus: For loops, while loops, do-while loops, nested loops, and controlling loop execution

lessons.title: Functions and Modular Programming
lessons.focus: Defining functions, parameters, arguments, return values, scope, and reusable code

lessons.title: Data Structures
lessons.focus: Arrays, lists, strings, tuples, sets, dictionaries, and basic data manipulation

lessons.title: Algorithms and Problem-Solving
lessons.focus: Breaking down problems, pseudocode, flowcharts, searching, sorting, and algorithm efficiency

lessons.title: Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.focus: Classes, objects, constructors, methods, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism

lessons.title: Error Handling and Debugging
lessons.focus: Syntax errors, runtime errors, logical errors, debugging techniques, and exception handling

lessons.title: File Handling
lessons.focus: Reading files, writing files, updating files, and working with different file formats

lessons.title: Advanced Programming Concepts
lessons.focus: Recursion, lambda functions, modules, libraries, higher-order functions, and basic asynchronous programming

lessons.title: Working with Data
lessons.focus: JSON, data processing, APIs, HTTP requests, and connecting programs to external services

lessons.title: Software Development Practices
lessons.focus: Code organization, naming conventions, documentation, testing, version control, and writing maintainable code

lessons.title: Practical Programming Projects
lessons.focus: Building a calculator, quiz application, expense tracker, student management system, and other real-world projects
